turns.text: They offered $35 for my $41 listing. What should I do?

turns.full_response_text: Counter near $39 and keep the tone firm but friendly. The $35 offer is about 15% under ask; a small counter preserves room without sounding desperate.

turns.text: The sleeve has a seam split, and shipping will cost me $6.

turns.full_response_text: Factor the $6 shipping and seam split into net proceeds. A $37–$38 counter can still clear a thin margin after shipping if you disclose the seam split clearly.

turns.text: I would accept $37, but I do not want to sound desperate.

turns.full_response_text: Anchor at $38 with a floor of $37. Signal condition honesty and shipping cost without apologizing for the ask.
